verdict.rationale: Rive's own docs say the editor creates "responsive layouts" and builds experiences that respond to screen size, and its AI agent can generate responsive layouts. That makes responsive layout a first-party capability, but the evidence is only one-line marketing mentions with no detail on how frames resize. Missing for 10: documented auto-layout behavior, constraints, grid layouts, how frames resize like real UIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, frames can behave responsively — auto layout, constraints, and grids resize designs the way real UIs flex

citations.quote: Create vector graphics, responsive layouts, and reusable components
Build interactive experiences that respond to user input, screen size, scrolling, and application state.
Generate scripts, responsive layouts, data models, and even animation.
